slides.title: We asked AI to edit our podcast
slides.sub: Two attempts that flopped, and the pipeline that worked.

slides.title: Attempt 1: let the agent click
slides.text: Quinn wrote down his editing process and let Codex drive Descript. Decent job, but sloppy, and it burned far more Descript credits than editing by hand.
slides.source: AS SAID ON THE FRINGELINES PODCAST · OCT 30, 2026

slides.text: of Doom's Descript credits, gone on one deck-to-video test. The video missed the mark.
slides.source: AS SAID ON THE FRINGELINES PODCAST · OCT 30, 2026

slides.text: I could have just done this in Descript.

slides.title: Show, don't tell
slides.text: Give the agent videos you like, name what makes them work, and save each style as a reusable skill. Then iterate, like you would with a new editor.
filler words and stutters cut automatically from one episode.

slides.title: Don't let agents click. Let them build.
slides.text: An agent writing a repeatable pipeline, with a human making the calls, turned one recording into an episode, shorts and these slides.
